The structure of MgNi (Mg₂Ni₂ per cell) is tetragonal with space group P4/mmm (No. 119) and four atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis gives each Mg center 14 geometric neighbors (6 Mg, 8 Ni), and each Ni center 10 neighbors (4 Mg, 6 Ni), with neighbor distances from about 2.51 to 3.14 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg and Ni polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between Mg polyhedra.
